skills.name: Brawler
skills.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff6703|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff6720|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

skills.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
skills.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7463|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3317|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

skills.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
skills.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3382|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10207|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Soul Splitting Trap
skills.description:
Lay claim to enemy souls, dealing |cffffff8772|r Magic Damage to your target and any other nearby enemies over |cffffff10|r seconds.

Fills an empty Soul Gem if an affected enemy dies.

skills.name: Resolving Vigor
skills.description:
Let loose a battle cry, instilling yourself with resolve and healing for |cffffff17874|r Health over |cffffff5|r seconds.

After casting you gain Minor Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff2974|r, for |cffffff20|r seconds.

skills.name: Replenishing Barrier
skills.description:
Invoke defensive tactics to protect yourself and nearby group members with wards that each absorb up to |cffffff43377|r damage. 

Each time a ward dissolves, you restore |cffffff1500|r Magicka.
